snippet.title: The Pink Robot | Official Trailer | Action Roguelite
snippet.description:
Navi the cat steps into Eugene's mind to bring him home, a world built only from his memories and feelings.
🎮 Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4251870

The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with fluid combat and deep build variety.
Eugene hasn't woken up. Inside his mind, painful feelings have twisted familiar memories into something hostile, and his mind fights back. Navi fights her way through, with a little help from a pink robot waiting in the Blanket Fort.

⚔️ Fight with the LumiBlade and the Color Burster, weapons born from childhood toys
🔗 Link Skills, Mementos and Instincts in the Neural Web to shape your own build
🤖 Grow stronger run after run with the Pink Robot's Imprints

LumiBlade or Color Burster: which one would you pick first?

#ThePinkRobot #Roguelite #IndieGame #indiedev
